template.name: desktop_automation_lava_vision
template.description: LAVA-shaped vision and desktop automation event template.
template.objective: Route visual and desktop events through LAVA-style event packets instead of screenshot-heavy prompt injection.

constraints.tool_context: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

sop: Represent visual observations as event packets and state changes.
Keep raw video or screenshot data out of the main chat context.
Return only compressed action and evidence summaries to the Web UI.
template.tool_context_rule: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

information_hierarchy.output: natural GUI reply plus evidence summary
